verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a minimal offline TOTP/HOTP one-time-code generator. A built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks is outside what a buyer comparing authenticator apps would reasonably expect, so this is a wrong-axis question rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence pack suggests the app ships any assistant or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
